'''Dalenshar''' is an area on the [[Seanchan]] [[Seanchan (continent)|continent]].

[[Kennar Miraj]] has troops that come from Dalenshar.{{ref/book|8|24}} People from Dalenshar, including [[Gamel Loune]] have black skin and a distinctive accent.{{ref/book|11|34}}
